mode: UTF-8, standard_conforming_strings on, pg_catalog first and the stock Boolean input and assignment behavior.
structure: The bound input is one exact native Boolean value. A deliberately typed cast can retain its Boolean destination and its already resolved literal argument. No literal spelling is required for a complete write.
conditions: Accept a complete unambiguous known Boolean token after removing surrounding ASCII whitespace and folding ASCII case. A VALUES or UPDATE Boolean assignment and a nondistinct simple INSERT SELECT apply the Boolean input conversion to an unknown literal. DISTINCT must resolve its source before assignment. Its unknown literal becomes text and is rejected for a Boolean target. An explicit builtin Boolean cast provides the typed result before DISTINCT.
meaning: Decode the same true or false as the builtin Boolean input function before storing or comparing it. A sequence containing a malformed input cannot publish a complete statement. Explicit TEXT is already typed and keeps its separate native assignment rule.
sql: Use TRUE or FALSE for a normalized value and preserve the explicit native cast role where it is recorded in a SELECT result.
observations: Native input value in the full target footprint and each RETURNING position
Exact ordered result metadata and duplicate and NULL effects
Exact SQLSTATE of malformed input or a typed assignment mismatch

finite.completeness: Decode and identify the independent raw input bytes and observed owning structure. Compare each exact context and spelling once. Verify the produced Boolean independently of the decoder shipped in the PHP candidate.

analysis: A Boolean literal with mixed case
A Boolean input with ASCII control whitespace
A signed and Boolean VALUES list
An explicitly cast Boolean literal under DISTINCT
The same input decoded by a schema default

exploration.requiredForms: Mix both Boolean destinations, typed and unknown inputs, case and ASCII whitespace, isolated and mixed write lists, DISTINCT casts, old-row fields and repeated return positions.
